candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that credits msg.value to the caller's balance, so Deposit no longer updates balances.
Replace the balance accumulation with assignment, so Deposit overwrites the caller's balance with msg.value instead of adding to it.
Credit tx.origin instead of msg.sender, so the deposit is recorded under a different key than the caller's address.
Replace the balance addition with a subtraction, so Deposit decrements the caller's balance (reverting if insufficient) instead of increasing it.
Remove the statement 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum never changes MinSum.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum += _val;' so MinSum accumulates the argument instead of being set to it.
Move 'MinSum = _val;' before the initialization check so the assignment happens even when the function reverts.
Remove the initialized guard so SetMinSum still updates MinSum after initialization.
Remove the assignment so SetMinSum never changes MinSum (it always stays 1 ether).
Invert the guard condition so the function only succeeds after initialization instead of before it.
Remove the initialized guard so SetLogFile can be called after initialization, changing Log.
Invert the guard condition so SetLogFile reverts before initialization and succeeds afterwards, changing Log.
Assign the zero address to Log instead of _log, changing the value of Log observable after any SetLogFile call.
